narratives.body: City Wire reports that Cedar United goalkeeper Kim Park will miss the next match due to an ankle injury, with no return date provided.
narratives.headline: Kim Park injury report

narratives.body: City Wire states that Cedar United appointed Jo Vale as head coach on Monday, with a two-year contract.
narratives.headline: Jo Vale appointed head coach

narratives.body: City Wire notes that Cedar United won 2–1 against Vale City on Sunday.
narratives.headline: Cedar United win against Vale City
